name: Payload / Spacecraft
summary: Customer satellite stack or Crew Dragon spacecraft carried atop the Stage 2 payload adapter.
function: Rides inside the fairing (or directly atop Stage 2 for Crew Dragon missions like DM-1) until orbital insertion and spacecraft separation after SECO.
materials: Mission-dependent spacecraft bus (aluminum/composite structure, solar arrays, or Crew Dragon pressure vessel + PICA-X heat shield).

specs.label: DM-1 Crew Dragon Mass
specs.source: NASA / Wikipedia Crew Dragon Demo-1 specs

history: Falcon 9 has launched commercial communications satellites, Starlink constellations, NASA ISS cargo/crew Dragon missions, and deep-space science probes.
sources: NASA Crew Dragon Demo-1 Press Kit
